floor_history.headline: Recon s1: floor re-measured 32 (chassis unchanged, all WIP-imported verdicts spendable); $v0/$v1 exchange confirmed at .greg disposition level (pseudo 100 in $v1, 83/84/98 in $v0); frontier = instrume

frontier.hypothesis: The $v0/$v1 exchange is decided by local-alloc's suggested-register machinery (qty_phys_copy_sugg/qty_phys_sugg) — the one allocation input the ra_solver does not model, explaining the NEGATIVE goal runs.
frontier.mechanism: pseudos copied to/from hard regs (call args/returns) record phys suggestions biasing local qty allocation and global allocno ordering; C-level copy-structure changes can flip the suggestion without touching refs/span/conflicts
frontier.next_probe: forensics: run instrumented cc1 (tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1) with BB2_*_DEBUG hooks; capture suggestion tables for pseudos 100/83/84/98; identify the creating copy insn and whether an honest C respelling changes it

frontier.hypothesis: A fresh-seed permuter campaign can find a spelling that flips the exchange even though directed search is closed.
frontier.mechanism: permuter mutations perturb pseudo birth order and copy structure, feeding the same unmodeled suggestion machinery
frontier.next_probe: tools/permuter_campaign.py per permuter-fresh-seed-discipline (~20-30k iters), waited in-turn; expectations calibrated per permuter-closability-evaluated

frontier.hypothesis: The 1-nop SCHED residual dissolves with the RA exchange; standalone attack is dead.
frontier.mechanism: nop is the delay slot of the late lw a0,24(s0) whose placement is RA-coupled; reorders measured inert (scheduler re-hoists)
frontier.next_probe: none until RA moves; re-diff after any RA win
